function validate(schema, value, at = 'input') {
  if (schema.oneOf) {
    const matches = schema.oneOf.filter(x => { try { validate(x, value, at); return true; } catch { return false; } });
    if (matches.length !== 1) fail('INVALID_INPUT', at + ': expected exactly one action shape');
    return;
  }
  if (schema.const !== undefined && value !== schema.const) fail('INVALID_INPUT', at + ': wrong constant');
  if (schema.enum && !schema.enum.includes(value)) fail('INVALID_INPUT', at + ': unsupported value');
  if (schema.type === 'object') {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value) || ![Object.prototype, null].includes(Object.getPrototypeOf(value))) fail('INVALID_INPUT', at + ': expected plain object');
    for (const key of Object.keys(value)) { if (!Object.hasOwn(schema.properties, key)) fail('INVALID_INPUT', at + ': unexpected field'); validate(schema.properties[key], value[key], at + '.' + key); }
    for (const key of schema.required || []) if (!Object.hasOwn(value, key)) fail('INVALID_INPUT', at + ': missing ' + key);
  } else if (schema.type === 'array') {
    if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length > LIMITS.nodes) fail('INVALID_INPUT', at + ': invalid array');
    value.forEach(x => validate(schema.items, x, at));
  } else if (schema.type === 'number') {
    if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || Math.abs(value) > 1000000) fail('INVALID_INPUT', at + ': invalid finite number');
  } else if (typeof value !== schema.type || (typeof value === 'string' && value.length > LIMITS.text)) fail('INVALID_INPUT', at + ': invalid ' + schema.type);
}
// Intentionally small CSS grammar: descendant/child, tag, #id, .class,
// [data-testid="..."], [role="..."], [aria-label="..."], [name="..."].
// No universal, lists, pseudo selectors, escapes, URL-bearing attributes or shell roots.
function checkSelector(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value || value.length > LIMITS.selector || value.split(/\s+|>/).filter(Boolean).length > 8 || !/^(?:[A-Za-z][\w-]*|[#.][\w-]+|\[(?:data-testid|role|aria-label|name)="[\w .:\-\u0400-\u04ff]{1,80}"\]|\s+|>)+$/.test(value)) fail('INVALID_SELECTOR', 'Selector is outside the supported grammar');
  return value;
}
function artifactPath(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > 512 || !/^artifacts\/(?:[\w .()\-\u0400-\u04ff]+\/)*[\w .()\-\u0400-\u04ff]+\.(?:html?|xhtml)$/i.test(value) || value.split('/').some(x => x === '.' || x === '..' || /[. ]$/.test(x))) fail('PATH_OUT_OF_SCOPE', 'Use a relative HTML path beneath artifacts/');
  return value;
}
function artifactLocation(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > 512 || !/^artifacts(?:\/[\w .()\-\u0400-\u04ff]+)*$/i.test(value) || value.split('/').some(x=>x==='.'||x==='..'||/[. ]$/.test(x))) fail('PATH_OUT_OF_SCOPE','Use a relative file/directory beneath artifacts');
  return value;
}
function checkInput(name, args) {
  const entry = CATALOG.find(x => x.name === name); if (!entry) fail('UNKNOWN_COMMAND', 'Unknown tool');
  if (jsonBytes(args) > LIMITS.inputBytes) fail('PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE', 'Input too large');
  validate(entry.input, args);
  if (args.path) { if (name === 'dsh_ui_panel_open' && ['files','terminal'].includes(args.kind)) artifactLocation(args.path); else artifactPath(args.path); }
  for (const selector of [args.selector, args.action?.selector]) if (selector !== undefined) checkSelector(selector);
  if (args.hash !== undefined && !/^#[\w.:-]{1,128}$/.test(args.hash)) fail('INVALID_INPUT', 'Invalid artifact hash');
  if (args.url !== undefined) { let u; try { u = new URL(args.url); } catch { fail('URL_NOT_ALLOWED','Invalid browser URL'); } if (!['https:','http:'].includes(u.protocol) || u.username || u.password || u.search || u.hash) fail('URL_NOT_ALLOWED','Only credential-free HTTP(S) URLs without query/hash are supported'); }
  if (args.limit !== undefined && (!Number.isInteger(args.limit) || args.limit < 1 || args.limit > LIMITS.nodes)) fail('INVALID_INPUT', 'limit must be 1..50');
  for (const key of ['timeMs', 'timeoutMs']) if (args[key] !== undefined && (!Number.isInteger(args[key]) || args[key] < 0 || args[key] > LIMITS.timeout)) fail('INVALID_INPUT', key + ' must be 0..15000');
  if (name.endsWith('_wait') && [args.selector !== undefined, args.text !== undefined, args.timeMs !== undefined].filter(Boolean).length !== 1) fail('INVALID_INPUT', 'wait requires exactly one of selector/text/timeMs');

  if (name.endsWith('_open') && [args.selector, args.hash, args.scroll].filter(x => x !== undefined).length > 1) fail('INVALID_INPUT', 'open accepts at most one navigation destination');
  if (name === 'dsh_ui_panel_open' && ((args.kind === 'browser') !== (args.url !== undefined) || (args.kind !== 'browser' && !args.path))) fail('INVALID_INPUT', 'browser needs url; other kinds need an artifact path');
  return args;
}
function authorSchema(schema) {
  if (schema.oneOf) return { oneOf: schema.oneOf.map(authorSchema) };
  const out = { ...schema }; delete out.required;
  if (schema.properties) out.properties = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(schema.properties).map(([k, v]) => [k, { ...authorSchema(v), ...(schema.required.includes(k) ? { required: true } : {}) }]));
  if (schema.items) out.items = authorSchema(schema.items);
  return out;
}
function result(context = {}, effect = 'none', data = {}, error = null, commandId = null) {
  return { ok: !error, commandId, context: { sessionId: context.sessionId || null, tabId: context.tabId || null, documentId: context.documentId || null, path: context.path || null, kind: context.kind || 'artifact' }, effect, data, error };
}
function errorResult(error, context, id) {
  const typed = typeof error?.code === 'string' && typeof error?.message === 'string';
  return result(context, ['none','applied','unknown'].includes(error?.effect) ? error.effect : 'none', {}, { code: typed ? error.code : 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: typed ? error.message.slice(0, 256) : 'Operation failed; details withheld' }, id);
}
function boundResult(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value.ok !== 'boolean' || !['none', 'applied', 'unknown'].includes(value.effect) || !value.context || !value.data || (value.error !== null && typeof value.error?.code !== 'string')) fail('INVALID_RECEIPT', 'Malformed result');
  if (jsonBytes(value) > (value.data.image ? LIMITS.captureBytes : LIMITS.bytes)) fail('PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE', 'Result exceeds size limit');
  return value;
}
const OUTPUT = object({ ok: b, commandId: { oneOf: [s, { type: 'null' }] }, context: object({ sessionId: { oneOf: [s, { type: 'null' }] }, tabId: { oneOf: [s, { type: 'null' }] }, documentId: { oneOf: [s, { type: 'null' }] }, path: { oneOf: [s, { type: 'null' }] }, kind: s }, ['sessionId','tabId','documentId','path','kind']), effect: en('none','applied','unknown'), data: { type: 'object', properties: {}, additionalProperties: true }, error: { oneOf: [{ type: 'null' }, object({ code: s, message: s }, ['code','message'])] } }, ['ok','commandId','context','effect','data','error']);


class FrameRegistry {
  constructor(win) { this.win = win; this.frames = new Map(); }
  attach({ sessionId, tabId, path, iframe }) {
    artifactPath(path);
    this.detach(tabId);
    const entry = { sessionId, tabId, path, kind:'artifact', iframe, documentId:this.win.crypto.randomUUID(), pending:new Map(), ready:false };
    const { port1, port2 } = new this.win.MessageChannel(); entry.port = port1;
    const invalidate = () => { if (this.frames.get(tabId) === entry) this.detach(tabId); };
    // Call attach from the iframe's load handler, never before the packaged
    // dispatcher is installed. The NEXT load invalidates this document lease.
    iframe.addEventListener('load',invalidate,{once:true}); entry.invalidate = invalidate;
    port1.onmessage = event => {
      if (event.data?.type === 'ready' && event.data.documentId === entry.documentId) { entry.ready = true; return; }
      const pending = entry.pending.get(event.data?.id);
      if (event.data?.type !== 'result' || !pending) return;
      entry.pending.delete(event.data.id); clearTimeout(pending.timer);
      try {
        const value = boundResult(event.data.value);
        if (value.context.sessionId !== entry.sessionId || value.context.tabId !== tabId || value.context.documentId !== entry.documentId || value.commandId !== event.data.id) fail('INVALID_RECEIPT','Iframe receipt identity mismatch');
        pending.resolve({ ...value, context:{ ...value.context, path:entry.path, kind:'artifact' } });
      } catch (e) { pending.resolve(errorResult(new ToolError('INVALID_RECEIPT',e.message,pending.mutating?'unknown':'none'),entry,event.data.id)); }
    };
    port1.start?.(); this.frames.set(tabId,entry);
    iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({ type:'dsh-artifact-tools-v1-connect', documentId:entry.documentId },'*',[port2]);
    return { documentId:entry.documentId, dispose:() => { if (this.frames.get(tabId) === entry) this.detach(tabId); } };
  }
  detach(tabId) {
    const e = this.frames.get(tabId); if (!e) return;
    this.frames.delete(tabId); e.iframe.removeEventListener('load',e.invalidate);
    e.port.postMessage({type:'dispose'}); e.port.close();
    for (const [id,p] of e.pending) { clearTimeout(p.timer); p.resolve(errorResult(new ToolError('STALE_DOCUMENT','Frame navigated or closed',p.mutating?'unknown':'none'),e,id)); }
    e.pending.clear();
  }
  target(sessionId, target) {
    const e = this.frames.get(target.tabId);
    if (!e || e.sessionId !== sessionId || !e.iframe.isConnected) fail('TAB_CLOSED','Artifact tab is not mounted for caller');
    if (e.documentId !== target.documentId) fail('STALE_DOCUMENT','Artifact document was replaced');
    if (!e.ready) fail('FRAME_NOT_READY','Packaged iframe dispatcher has not acknowledged');
    return e;
  }
  async execute(cmd) {
    const e = this.target(cmd.sessionId,cmd.args.target), delay = cmd.deadline - Date.now();
    if (delay <= 0) fail('TIMEOUT','Frame command expired');
    const a = cmd.args.action;
    const needsFocus = a?.kind === 'focus' || a?.kind === 'press' && !(a.key === 'Enter' && a.submit === true);
    if (needsFocus && (!this.win.document.hasFocus() || this.win.document.activeElement !== e.iframe)) fail('FOCUS_NOT_OWNED','Artifact must already own focus for focus/press');
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const mutating = MUTATING.has(cmd.name);
      const timer = setTimeout(() => { e.pending.delete(cmd.id); resolve(errorResult(new ToolError(mutating?'UNKNOWN_EFFECT':'TIMEOUT','Iframe receipt deadline exceeded',mutating?'unknown':'none'),e,cmd.id)); },delay);
      e.pending.set(cmd.id,{ resolve,timer,mutating });
      e.port.postMessage({ type:'focus-state', owned:this.win.document.hasFocus() && this.win.document.activeElement === e.iframe });
      e.port.postMessage({ type:'execute', command:{...cmd,path:e.path} });
    });
  }
  dispose() { for (const id of [...this.frames.keys()]) this.detach(id); }
}

// Native adapter uses only the observed sidebar controller. Optional kinds are
// explicit integration providers, never guessed kind IDs or shell DOM selectors.
function createPanelAdapter({ sidebar, frames, mountedSession, readTabs, providers = {}, focusSafe = () => false }) {
  const assertSession = id => { if (mountedSession() !== id) fail('SESSION_NOT_VISIBLE','Caller session is not mounted; no chat switch was made'); };
  const artifactTabs = async sessionId => {
    const rows=await readTabs(sessionId),known=[...frames.frames.values()].filter(e=>e.sessionId===sessionId),ids=new Set([...rows.filter(t=>t.safeKind==='artifact').map(t=>t.id),...known.map(e=>e.tabId)]);
    return [...ids].slice(0,50).map(tabId=>{const e=known.find(e=>e.tabId===tabId),r=rows.find(r=>r.id===tabId);return {tabId,documentId:e?.documentId||null,path:e?.path||r?.path||null,kind:'artifact',ready:!!e?.ready,active:r?.active===true};});
  };
  const context = (sessionId,row) => ({sessionId,...row});
  const checkFocus = focus => { if (focus && !focusSafe()) fail('FOCUS_NOT_OWNED','Explicit focus would interrupt user activity'); };
  return {
    async execute(cmd, signal) {
      let issued = false;
      try {
      const guard = () => { if (signal?.aborted) fail('ABORTED','Panel runtime stopped'); if (Date.now() >= cmd.deadline) fail('TIMEOUT','Panel command expired'); assertSession(cmd.sessionId); };
      guard();
      assertSession(cmd.sessionId); checkInput(cmd.name,cmd.args);
      const a = cmd.args, sessionId = cmd.sessionId;
      if (cmd.name === 'dsh_artifact_tabs') return result({sessionId},'none',{tabs:await artifactTabs(sessionId)},null,cmd.id);
      if (cmd.name === 'dsh_ui_panel_tabs') {
        // Content, outside paths, arbitrary page titles and terminal buffers are
        // not exposed. Kind/id/active are sufficient for choosing a panel.
        const tabs = (await readTabs(sessionId)).slice(0,50).map(t => ({tabId:t.id,kind:['artifact','files','browser','terminal'].includes(t.safeKind)?t.safeKind:'other',active:t.active === true}));
        return result({sessionId,kind:'panel'},'none',{tabs},null,cmd.id);
      }
      if (cmd.name === 'dsh_artifact_close') {
        const e = frames.target(sessionId,a.target);
        issued = true; sidebar.close(e.tabId);
        const stillOpen = (await readTabs(sessionId)).some(t => t.id === e.tabId);
        if (stillOpen) { issued = false; fail('CLOSE_REFUSED','Native panel retained the tab'); }
        frames.detach(e.tabId); return result(e,'applied',{closed:true},null,cmd.id);
      }
      if (cmd.name === 'dsh_artifact_open' || cmd.name === 'dsh_ui_panel_open' && a.kind === 'artifact') {
        artifactPath(a.path); checkFocus(a.focus);
        if (a.reload && !providers.reload) fail('UNSUPPORTED_ACTION','Native reload hook is not integrated');
        const before = (await readTabs(sessionId)).filter(t => t.safeKind === 'artifact');
        const previousIds = new Set(before.map(t=>t.id));
        const address = 'dsh-resource://file/session/' + encodeURIComponent(sessionId) + '/' + a.path.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');
        const current = sidebar.active();
        if (a.placement === 'current' && current && !before.some(t => t.id === current.id)) fail('TARGET_OUT_OF_SCOPE','Current tab is not an artifact');
        issued = true;
        sidebar.openResource(address, { ...(a.placement === 'current' && current ? {replaceTab:current.id}:{}), ...(a.placement === 'new'?{revealIfOpened:false}:{} ) });
        const after = (await readTabs(sessionId)).filter(t=>t.safeKind==='artifact'&&t.path===a.path);
        const expected = a.placement==='new' ? after.find(t=>!previousIds.has(t.id)) : after.find(t=>t.id===sidebar.active()?.id)||after.find(t=>t.id===current?.id)||after.find(t=>!previousIds.has(t.id))||(after.length===1?after[0]:null);
        if (!expected) throw new ToolError('UNKNOWN_EFFECT','Open issued but exact destination tab was not observed','unknown');
        // Await the actual mount/ready and identify by exact caller path, never a
        // latest-chat fallback. A failed receipt after open has unknown effect.
        let entry;
        while (Date.now() < cmd.deadline) {
          guard();
          entry = [...frames.frames.values()].find(e => e.sessionId === sessionId && e.tabId===expected.id && e.path === a.path && e.ready);
          if (entry) break;
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r,50));
        }
        if (!entry) throw new ToolError('UNKNOWN_EFFECT','Open issued but target did not become ready','unknown');
        if (a.reload) {
          const old = entry.documentId;
          await providers.reload(entry,{signal,deadline:cmd.deadline});
          entry = null;
          while (Date.now() < cmd.deadline) { guard(); entry = [...frames.frames.values()].find(e => e.sessionId === sessionId && e.tabId===expected.id && e.path === a.path && e.ready && e.documentId !== old); if (entry) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); }
          if (!entry) throw new ToolError('UNKNOWN_EFFECT','Reload issued but new document not ready','unknown');
        }
        guard(); if (a.focus) sidebar.focus(entry.tabId);
        if (a.selector || a.hash || a.scroll) {
          const value = await frames.execute({...cmd,name:'dsh_artifact_navigate',args:{target:{tabId:entry.tabId,documentId:entry.documentId},...(a.selector?{selector:a.selector}:{}),...(a.hash?{hash:a.hash}:{}),...(a.scroll?{scroll:a.scroll}:{})}});
          if (!value.ok) return {...value,effect:'applied'};
        }
        return result(context(sessionId,entry),'applied',{opened:true,reloaded:!!a.reload},null,cmd.id);
      }
      if (cmd.name === 'dsh_ui_panel_open') {
        checkFocus(a.focus);
        if (!providers[a.kind]) fail('UNSUPPORTED_PANEL','Panel provider is not configured: '+a.kind);
        // Provider receives validated artifact path or policy-checked URL. It may
        // open a tab only; terminal commands/content and external file reads are absent.
        let data;
        try { data = await providers[a.kind]({sessionId,path:a.path,url:a.url,focus:!!a.focus,deadline:cmd.deadline,signal}); }
        catch(e) { if (!e?.code) throw new ToolError('UNKNOWN_EFFECT','Panel provider failed after invocation','unknown'); throw e; }
        return result({sessionId,kind:a.kind,tabId:data.tabId,path:a.path},data.effect || 'applied',{opened:true},null,cmd.id);
      }
      return await frames.execute(cmd);
      } catch (e) { if (issued && (!e?.effect || e.effect === 'none')) throw new ToolError(e?.code||'UNKNOWN_EFFECT',e?.code&&e?.message?e.message:'Panel operation failed after issue','unknown'); throw e; }
    }
  };
}

function createChannel(fetch, endpoint, capability, instance) {
  return async (op, payload = {}, signal) => {
    const response = await fetch(endpoint,{method:'POST',mode:'same-origin',credentials:'same-origin',cache:'no-store',signal,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+capability.token},body:JSON.stringify({op,sessionId:capability.sessionId,clientId:capability.clientId,instance,...payload})});
    const text = await response.text(); if (text.length > LIMITS.bytes) fail('PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE','Bridge response too large');
    const value = JSON.parse(text); if (!response.ok || !value.ok) fail(value.error?.code || 'BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE',value.error?.message || 'Bridge rejected request');
    return value.data;
  };
}
function startClient({ sessionId, readBootstrap, adapter, fetch, endpoint = '/artifact-panes/tools-v1/channel', crypto, onStatus = () => {} }) {
  const abort = new AbortController(), instance = crypto.randomUUID(); let channel, busy = false, stopped = false;
  const tick = async () => {
    if (stopped || busy) return; busy = true;
    try {
      if (!channel) {
        const c = await readBootstrap(sessionId,abort.signal);
        if (c.version !== VERSION || c.sessionId !== sessionId || typeof c.token !== 'string' || typeof c.clientId !== 'string') fail('UNAUTHORIZED','Bootstrap identity mismatch');
        channel = createChannel(fetch,endpoint,c,instance);
      }
      const cmd = await channel('poll',{},abort.signal);
      if (!cmd) { onStatus({state:'ready',sessionId}); return; }
      if (cmd.sessionId !== sessionId || cmd.version !== VERSION || cmd.deadline <= Date.now()) fail('STALE_COMMAND','Command identity/deadline mismatch');
      // Host must ACK start BEFORE any mutation. Lost ACK means no execution.
      await channel('receipt',{id:cmd.id,phase:'start'},abort.signal);
      if (Date.now() >= cmd.deadline || stopped) fail('TIMEOUT','Command expired before local execution');
      let value;
      const operation = new AbortController(),cancel = () => operation.abort();
      abort.signal.addEventListener('abort',cancel,{once:true});
      const deadlineTimer = setTimeout(cancel,Math.max(1,cmd.deadline-Date.now()));
      try { value = await adapter.execute(cmd,operation.signal); }
      catch(e) { value = errorResult(e,{sessionId,...cmd.args.target,path:cmd.args.path},cmd.id); }
      finally {clearTimeout(deadlineTimer);abort.signal.removeEventListener('abort',cancel);}
      if (stopped) return;
      await channel('receipt',{id:cmd.id,phase:'done',value},abort.signal);
      onStatus({state:'receipt',sessionId,commandId:cmd.id,effect:value.effect});
    } catch(e) {
      onStatus({state:'error',sessionId,code:e.code || 'BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE'});
      // Never replay an execution, even when sending its done receipt failed.
      if (['UNAUTHORIZED','STALE_COMMAND'].includes(e.code)) channel = null;
    } finally { busy = false; }
  };
  const pollTimer = setInterval(tick,300);
  const heartbeat = setInterval(() => { if (channel && !stopped) channel('heartbeat',{},abort.signal).catch(e=>onStatus({state:'error',code:e.code || 'BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE',sessionId})); },1500);
  tick();
  return { stop() { stopped = true; clearInterval(pollTimer); clearInterval(heartbeat); abort.abort(); }, tick };
}

async function readWorkspaceBootstrap(ctx, sessionId, signal) {
  const digest = await globalThis.crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(sessionId));
  const key = [...new Uint8Array(digest)].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('').slice(0,24);
  const value = await ctx.remote.workspaceFiles.readBytes(sessionId,'.dsh/artifact-panes/tools-v1/'+key+'.json',{},signal);
  if (!value || value.ok === false || !value.value?.data || value.value.data.length > 4096) fail('BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE','Private bootstrap is not available yet; run artifact_list first');
  return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(value.value.data));
}

function nativeTabMetadata(sidebar, sessionId) {
  if (typeof sidebar.tabsIn !== 'function') fail('UNSUPPORTED_PANEL','Native tabsIn source contract changed');
  const active = sidebar.active()?.id;
  return sidebar.tabsIn(sessionId).map(t => {
    let artifact;
    try {
      const prefix = 'dsh-resource://file/session/' + encodeURIComponent(sessionId) + '/';
      if (t.kind === 'artifact' && t.contentId.startsWith(prefix)) artifact = artifactPath(t.contentId.slice(prefix.length).split('/').map(decodeURIComponent).join('/'));
    } catch {}
    return {id:t.id, safeKind:artifact?'artifact':['files','browser','terminal'].includes(t.kind)?t.kind:'other',active:t.id===active,...(artifact?{path:artifact}:{})};
  });
}

function createNativeBrowserProvider(sidebar, { allowedOrigins = [] } = {}) {
  return async ({sessionId,url,focus}) => {
    const u = new URL(url);
    if (!allowedOrigins.includes(u.origin) || !['http:','https:'].includes(u.protocol) || u.username || u.password || u.search || u.hash) fail('URL_NOT_ALLOWED','Browser URL is not permitted by integration policy');
    const before = new Set(nativeTabMetadata(sidebar,sessionId).map(t=>t.id));
    sidebar.openTab('browser',{params:{url:u.href},revealIfOpened:false});
    const opened = nativeTabMetadata(sidebar,sessionId).find(t=>t.safeKind==='browser'&&!before.has(t.id));
    if (!opened) throw new ToolError('UNKNOWN_EFFECT','Browser open issued but new tab identity was not observed','unknown');
    if (focus) sidebar.focus(opened.id);
    return {tabId:opened.id,effect:'applied'};
  };
}

function createClientRuntime({ win = window, ctx, sessionId, providers = {}, captureProvider = null, captureFactory, allowedBrowserOrigins = [], onStatus }) {
  const frames = new FrameRegistry(win), sidebar = ctx.sidebarRight;
  if (typeof captureFactory !== 'function') throw new Error('Supply packaged createCaptureAdapter');
  const panel = createPanelAdapter({sidebar,frames,mountedSession:()=>sidebar.mounted.getSnapshot(),readTabs:id=>nativeTabMetadata(sidebar,id),providers:{browser:createNativeBrowserProvider(sidebar,{allowedOrigins:allowedBrowserOrigins}),...providers},focusSafe:()=>win.document.hasFocus()&&[...frames.frames.values()].some(e=>win.document.activeElement===e.iframe)});
  const capture = captureFactory({frames,provider:captureProvider});
  const adapter = {execute:(cmd,signal)=>{if(sidebar.mounted.getSnapshot()!==cmd.sessionId)fail('SESSION_NOT_VISIBLE','Caller session is not mounted');return cmd.name==='dsh_artifact_screenshot'?capture(cmd):panel.execute(cmd,signal);}};
  const client = startClient({sessionId,readBootstrap:(id,signal)=>readWorkspaceBootstrap(ctx,id,signal),adapter,fetch:win.fetch.bind(win),crypto:win.crypto,onStatus});
  return {frames,stop(){client.stop();frames.dispose();}};
}


// No default screenshot backend. Existing shot.ps1 PrintWindow is forbidden here.
// A provider must attest that it receives ONLY artifact pixels, not a full
// window image later cropped. Integration must independently verify the claim.
function createCaptureAdapter({ frames, provider = null }) {
  return async cmd => {
    const e = frames.target(cmd.sessionId,cmd.args.target); artifactPath(e.path);
    if (!provider || provider.verifiedArtifactOnly !== true || provider.scope !== 'artifact-region' || typeof provider.capture !== 'function') throw new ToolError('CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE','Verified artifact-region capture provider is not installed');
    const before = e.iframe.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!before.width || !before.height || before.width > 4096 || before.height > 4096) throw new ToolError('CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE','Artifact region is not a supported visible size');
    const image = await provider.capture({ sessionId:e.sessionId,tabId:e.tabId,documentId:e.documentId,artifactElement:e.iframe,deadline:cmd.deadline });
    const current = frames.target(cmd.sessionId,cmd.args.target);
    const after = current.iframe.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (['x','y','width','height'].some(k=>Math.abs(before[k]-after[k])>0.5)) throw new ToolError('CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE','Artifact moved during capture; discarded');
    if (image.scope !== 'artifact-region' || image.documentId !== e.documentId || image.mimeType !== 'image/png' || !Number.isInteger(image.width) || !Number.isInteger(image.height) || image.width < 1 || image.height < 1 || image.width > 4096 || image.height > 4096 || typeof image.base64 !== 'string' || !/^iVBORw0KGgo[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(image.base64) || image.base64.length > 1400000) throw new ToolError('CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE','Capture provider did not return a bounded artifact-only PNG');
    return result(e,'none',{image:{mimeType:image.mimeType,base64:image.base64,width:image.width,height:image.height}},null,cmd.id);
  };
}


// One poller for the mounted caller session. Retained frames reconnect when a
// session returns, without loading any chat or activating an OS window.
function createRuntimeCoordinator({ win = window, ctx, providers = {}, captureProvider = null, allowedBrowserOrigins = [], onStatus }) {
  const descriptors = new Map(); let current, runtime;
  const attach = descriptor => runtime?.frames.attach(descriptor);
  const sync = () => {
    const id = ctx.sidebarRight.mounted.getSnapshot();
    if (id === current) return;
    runtime?.stop(); runtime = null; current = id;
    if (typeof id !== 'string' || !id) return;
    runtime = createClientRuntime({win,ctx,sessionId:id,captureFactory:createCaptureAdapter,captureProvider,allowedBrowserOrigins,onStatus,providers:{...providers,reload:async (entry,operation)=>{
      const descriptor = descriptors.get(entry.tabId);
      if (!descriptor || descriptor.sessionId !== id || typeof descriptor.reload !== 'function') fail('UNSUPPORTED_ACTION','Fresh-file reload callback is not integrated');
      await descriptor.reload(operation);
    }}});
    for (const descriptor of descriptors.values()) if (descriptor.sessionId === id && descriptor.iframe.isConnected) attach(descriptor);
  };
  const unsubscribe = ctx.sidebarRight.mounted.subscribe(sync); sync();
  return {
    // Invoke after the frame load event; the dispatcher must be installed first.
    registerFrame(descriptor) {
      try { artifactPath(descriptor.path); }
      catch(e) { onStatus?.({state:'excluded',sessionId:descriptor.sessionId,code:e.code});return()=>{}; }
      if (typeof descriptor.sessionId !== 'string' || typeof descriptor.tabId !== 'string' || !descriptor.iframe?.contentWindow) fail('INVALID_INPUT','Invalid artifact frame descriptor');
      descriptors.set(descriptor.tabId,descriptor);
      if (descriptor.sessionId === current) attach(descriptor);
      return () => {
        if (descriptors.get(descriptor.tabId) !== descriptor) return;
        descriptors.delete(descriptor.tabId); runtime?.frames.detach(descriptor.tabId);
      };
    },
    stop() { unsubscribe();runtime?.stop();runtime=null;descriptors.clear();current=null; }
  };
}

function withPackagedDispatcher(html, packagedSource) {
  if (typeof html !== 'string' || typeof packagedSource !== 'string') throw new Error('Static packaged HTML/source required');
  const script = '<script>' + packagedSource.replace(/<\/script/gi,'<\\/script') + '<'+'/script>';
  const at = html.search(/<\/body\s*>/i);
  return at < 0 ? html + script : html.slice(0,at) + script + html.slice(at);
}

window.DSHArtifactToolsV1=Object.freeze({createRuntimeCoordinator,withPackagedDispatcher,createClientRuntime,createCaptureAdapter,FrameRegistry,createPanelAdapter,readWorkspaceBootstrap,nativeTabMetadata});
})();

native validation focus was not requested');\n      if (typeof form.requestSubmit !== 'function') fail('UNSUPPORTED_ACTION','Form submission API is unavailable');\n      const cancel = event => event.preventDefault();\n      form.addEventListener('submit',cancel,true);\n      try { if (a.kind === 'click') el.click(); else form.requestSubmit(submitButton || undefined); } finally { form.removeEventListener('submit',cancel,true); }\n      return { changed: 'submit', nativeNavigationPrevented: true };\n    }\n    if (a.kind === 'click') { el.click(); return { changed: 'click', trusted: false }; }\n    if (a.kind === 'press') {\n      focus(el);\n      const allowed = el.dispatchEvent(new win.KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: a.key, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));\n      el.dispatchEvent(new win.KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key: a.key, bubbles: true }));\n      // Synthetic key events do not implement browser default actions.\n      return { changed: 'keyboard-event', key: a.key, trusted: false, defaultAction: false, cancelled: !allowed };\n    }\n    fail('UNSUPPORTED_ACTION', 'Unsupported artifact action');\n  };\n  return async function execute(cmd, signal) {\n    const context = { sessionId: cmd.sessionId, ...cmd.args.target, path: cmd.path || null };\n    let started = false;\n    try {\n      checkInput(cmd.name,cmd.args); guard(cmd,signal);\n      const a = cmd.args;\n      if (cmd.name === 'dsh_artifact_query') {\n        const fields = a.fields || ['text','rect'], nodes = Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll(a.selector)).slice(0, (a.limit || LIMITS.nodes) + 1), matches = [];\n        let chars = 0, budgetTruncated = false;\n        for (const el of nodes.slice(0,a.limit || LIMITS.nodes)) {\n          if (protectedElement(el)) continue;\n          const item = { tag: el.tagName.toLowerCase() };\n          if (fields.includes('text')) { item.text = text(el).slice(0, Math.max(0, 16000 - chars)); chars += item.text.length; }\n          if (fields.includes('rect')) item.rect = rect(el);\n          if (fields.includes('attrs')) item.attrs = Object.fromEntries(['id','role','aria-label','aria-expanded','aria-checked','data-testid','type'].filter(k => el.hasAttribute(k)).map(k => [k,String(el.getAttribute(k)).slice(0,256)]));\n          if (fields.includes('style')) { const style = win.getComputedStyle(el); item.style = Object.fromEntries(['display','position','width','height','color','background-color','font-size','overflow-x','overflow-y','opacity'].map(k => [k,style.getPropertyValue(k).slice(0,128)])); }\n          if (jsonBytes({matches:[...matches,item]}) > LIMITS.bytes-2048) { budgetTruncated = true;break; }\n          matches.push(item);\n        }\n        return result(context,'none',{ matches, truncated: budgetTruncated || nodes.length > (a.limit || LIMITS.nodes) || chars >= 16000 },null,cmd.id);\n      }\n      if (cmd.name === 'dsh_artifact_wait') {\n        const begun = now(), stop = Math.min(cmd.deadline, begun + (a.timeoutMs ?? LIMITS.timeout));\n        while (true) {\n          guard(cmd,signal);\n          let satisfied;\n          if (a.timeMs !== undefined) satisfied = now() - begun >= a.timeMs;\n          else if (a.text !== undefined) satisfied = text(doc.body).includes(a.text);\n          else { const found = doc.querySelector(a.selector); satisfied = (a.state === 'absent') ? !found : !!found && !protectedElement(found); }\n          if (satisfied) return result(context,'none',{ satisfied: true, elapsedMs: now() - begun },null,cmd.id);\n          if (now() >= stop) fail('TIMEOUT','Artifact wait condition was not met');\n          await new Promise(resolve => { const t = setTimeout(done,50); function done() { clearTimeout(t); signal?.removeEventListener('abort',done); resolve(); } signal?.addEventListener('abort',done,{once:true}); });\n        }\n      }\n      if (cmd.name === 'dsh_artifact_navigate') {\n        const el = a.selector ? requireElement(a.selector) : a.hash ? doc.getElementById(a.hash.slice(1)) : null;\n        if ((a.selector || a.hash) && !el) fail('ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND','Navigation target not found');\n        if (el && protectedElement(el)) fail('PROTECTED_ELEMENT','Private navigation target');\n        started = true;\n        if (el) scrollWithinArtifact(el);\n        if (a.hash) win.location.hash = a.hash;\n        if (a.scroll) win.scrollTo({ left:a.scroll.x, top:a.scroll.y, behavior:'instant' });\n        return result(context,'applied',{ changed:'navigation', hash:a.hash || null },null,cmd.id);\n      }\n      if (cmd.name === 'dsh_artifact_act') {\n        // Errors thrown before dispatch retain effect:none. Any exception from an\n        // event handler/DOM mutation may have partially applied and is unknown.\n        const el = requireElement(a.action.selector);\n        if (el.disabled || el.getAttribute?.('aria-disabled') === 'true') fail('ELEMENT_DISABLED','Element is disabled');\n        // Preflight to avoid marking policy errors as ambiguous.\n        if (['focus','press'].includes(a.action.kind) && !focusAllowed() && !(a.action.key === 'Enter' && a.action.submit && el.form)) fail('FOCUS_NOT_OWNED','Artifact does not own focus');\n        started = true;\n        const data = doAct(a.action);\n        return result(context,'applied',data,null,cmd.id);\n      }\n      fail('UNSUPPORTED_ACTION','Command is not an iframe operation');\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (started && typeof e?.code !== 'string') return errorResult({code:'UNKNOWN_EFFECT',message:'Artifact action failed after dispatch',effect:'unknown'},context,cmd.id);\n      return errorResult(e,context,cmd.id);\n    }\n  };\n}\n\nfunction installIframeDispatcher(win = window) {\n  let port, controller;\n  const connect = event => {\n    if (event.source !== win.parent || event.data?.type !== 'dsh-artifact-tools-v1-connect' || !event.ports?.[0] || typeof event.data.documentId !== 'string') return;\n    controller?.abort(); port?.close();\n    port = event.ports[0]; controller = new AbortController();\n    const ownedPort = port, signal = controller.signal, seen = new Map();\n    let focusOwned = false;\n    const run = createIframeExecutor(win,{ documentId:event.data.documentId, focusAllowed:() => focusOwned });\n    port.onmessage = async e => {\n      if (e.data?.type === 'dispose') { if (port === ownedPort) controller.abort(); ownedPort.close(); return; }\n      if (e.data?.type === 'focus-state') { focusOwned = e.data.owned === true; return; }\n      const cmd = e.data?.command;\n      for (const [id,deadline] of seen) if (Date.now() >= deadline) seen.delete(id);\n      if (e.data?.type !== 'execute' || !cmd || seen.has(cmd.id)) return;\n      if (seen.size >= 256) { ownedPort.postMessage({type:'result',id:cmd.id,value:errorResult({code:'DOCUMENT_COMMAND_LIMIT',message:'Too many unexpired document commands'}, {sessionId:cmd.sessionId,...cmd.args?.target},cmd.id)}); return; }\n      seen.set(cmd.id,cmd.deadline);\n      const value = await run(cmd,signal); if (port === ownedPort && !signal.aborted) ownedPort.postMessage({ type:'result', id:cmd.id, value });\n    };\n    port.start?.(); port.postMessage({ type:'ready', documentId:event.data.documentId });\n  };\n  win.addEventListener('message',connect);\n  return () => { win.removeEventListener('message',connect); controller?.abort(); port?.close(); };\n}\n\ninstallIframeDispatcher(window);\n})();\n";
